chose: The bundle artifact keeps the newest one for its day (keep 1, TTL 1) rather than being consumed in its run, so retention.yml runs after Snips Capture.
gray: Home picks the bundle up after the run; keep 0 lets the hourly sweep delete it before home can, while one day is still the repo's default life.
undo: Set the snips-bundle family to keep 0 and drop Snips Capture from retention.yml's workflow_run list.
